components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one chromatic button on a screen; renders in the user's chosen accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; background: var(--primary, #c96442); color: #ffffff; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--background, #faf7f2), 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #c96442) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action: sand surface, ink text, quiet next to the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; background: var(--secondary, #e8e6dc); color: var(--secondary-foreground, #4d4c48); font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4dccc); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #f0eee6); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #c96442) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Pure-white surface with warm sand border on the cream canvas; flat at rest, soft lift on hover.
components.html:
Ring 2 — Scent Work
Interior Search, Excellent A. 14 entries, judging starts 9:00 AM.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--card-foreground, #141413); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4dccc); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border, #e4dccc), rgba(61, 37, 22, 0.06) 0 8px 28px; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #8c8376); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White fill matching cards, with accent-tinted focus ring; 44px touch height.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 44px; width: 260px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--input, #ffffff); color: var(--input-text, #141413); font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--input-border, #e4dccc); border-radius: 8px; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #8c8376); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--input-border-hover, #d1cfc5); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #f2c8a8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring, #f2c8a8); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill chip from the hue-named pair system; tinted background, same-hue ink.
components.html: Checked in Conflict No status
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.6; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-chip-green { background: var(--chip-green-bg, #dcfce7); color: var(--chip-green-fg, #166534); } .ds-chip-amber { background: var(--chip-amber-bg, #fef3c7); color: var(--chip-amber-fg, #92400e); } .ds-chip-stone { background: var(--chip-stone-bg, #f1efe7); color: var(--chip-stone-fg, #3a3a36); }

components.name: Live Indicator
components.description: Ring Green badge reserved exclusively for judging-in-progress.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--live-tint, #f1f8f1); color: var(--live-ink, #385a3b); font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-live-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--live, #4e7c53); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar item: stone at rest, accent tint fill when active.
components.html: EntriesShow MapReports
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 200px; font-family: Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #8c8376); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--foreground, #181411); background: var(--muted, #f0eee6); } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--accent, #fdf5ef); color: var(--accent-foreground, #7c4a2e); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring, #f2c8a8); }

narrative.overview: Warm early light at the venue. Rings taped, catalogs stacked, armbands sorted — everything laid out and ready before the first dog runs. The interface should feel like that hour: calm, prepared, unhurried, and quietly warm. The visual foundation is warm paper, not cold glass: a catalog-cream canvas carrying pure-white cards with warm sand borders and ink text. Montserrat carries the entire working interface; Fraunces serif appears only at celebration moments (The Podium). Color arrives through a user-selectable accent (Clay, Grove, Dusk, Heather); components speak var(--primary) and let the user's preference flow through. Dark mode is a different time of day, not an inversion. Built for older, non-technical users operating outdoors: 44px targets, scalable 16px+ text, density preferences, and calm offline states.
keyCharacteristics: Warm catalog-cream canvas (#faf7f2) with exclusively warm-toned neutrals; pure white reserved for cards and inputs
User-selectable accent system (Clay / Grove / Dusk / Heather) wired through --primary
Montserrat for all working UI, display headings included; Fraunces reserved for celebration moments (The Podium)
Flat by default; warm ring shadows and soft lifts appear in response to interaction
Semantic status-color vocabulary never used decoratively
Accessibility as identity: 44px targets, font scaling, density preferences, calm offline states
Token layering: base UI tokens, v2 surface overrides (index.css @layer base — canonical), accent system, redesign tokens, chip pairs

rules.name: The Accent Is the User's Rule
rules.body: Components never hardcode #c96442 or any accent hex. Always var(--primary), var(--accent), var(--ring). A component that only looks right in Clay is broken.

rules.name: The Ring Green Rule
rules.body: Ring Green (#4e7c53) appears only on live-judging indicators. Never for success states, never for decoration.

rules.name: The Status Is Sacred Rule
rules.body: Status colors are a vocabulary the whole show day depends on. Never repurpose a status color for decoration, and never invent a new status color when one exists.

rules.name: The Podium Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is forbidden in working UI. If the screen helps someone do a task, it is Montserrat. If the screen honors something a dog just did — a placement, a title, a qualifying run — Fraunces may speak. Use .display-serif above ~20px and .celebration-serif below it.

rules.name: The Font Scale Rule
rules.body: Body and h3-and-below sizes multiply by --font-scale (user preference); h1/h2 use viewport clamps instead. Never set working text in fixed px that escapes the scale, and never below 12px equivalent.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns a shadow by being interacted with or by floating above the page (modal, popover, toast). Resting content stays flat.

dos: Do keep every neutral warm-toned — if a gray has no yellow-brown undertone, it doesn't belong here.
Do route all accent color through var(--primary) / var(--accent) tokens so Clay, Grove, Dusk, and Heather all render correctly.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum and body text at 16px+ before user scaling — the audience is older, outdoors, often wearing gloves.
Do use the existing status vocabulary (--status-*, chip pairs) for any state communication; check both light and dark renderings.
Do make offline and sync states quiet and reassuring — offline is normal, not broken.
Do write plain-English microcopy in dog-show terminology; plain language beats clever language.
Do add new tokens to the layer they belong to (base / accent / redesign / chip) rather than introducing one-off values.
donts: Don't build flashy or trendy product UI that competes with the work — no gradient text, no glassmorphism as decoration, no hero-metric dashboards.
Don't create dense passive tool palettes that leave a new secretary wondering what to do next — each role gets one clear home and one clear next step.
Don't use wizard-heavy workflows for interrupt-driven show-day tasks or confirmation dialogs for routine actions.
Don't ship tiny controls, hover-only affordances, gesture-only actions, or text that is hard to read outdoors.
Don't show technical error messages, sync anxiety, or anything that makes poor connectivity feel like user failure.
Don't use pure white as a page background (cards and inputs are the sanctioned white surfaces), pure black as text, or cool blue-grays anywhere outside the status vocabulary.
Don't hardcode #c96442 (or any accent hex) in a component — it breaks the other three accents.
Don't use Fraunces in working UI (headings, body, buttons, labels, tables), Ring Green outside live-judging, or status colors as decoration.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) on cards or alerts; use full borders, tints, or nothing.
Don't reach for a modal first — exhaust inline and progressive disclosure; modals are for genuine interruptions.
